about: Hand decisions about MX4 stat blocks that scripts/msh/roster.py applies after parsing (scripts/msh/gridbooks.py reads this book), and four text verdicts scripts/msh/npcs.py applies. Every value was read off the page image by the survey (apps/marvel-heroes/docs/surveys/mx4.md, Stat blocks: each value on a crop of the page image, 2026-11-01; decisions 4 and 7); none is a guess from OCR.
Facts only - numbers, rank codes and a few words of a label - so this file is committed while roster.json stays in the local cache.
match     {page, header}: the printed page in the Adventure Book and the start of the entry's header
verdict   misprint    the book prints a value its own arithmetic contradicts; 'printed' keeps what the page says, 'corrected' what the rules give
as_printed  the page is unambiguous and the check still fails; kept as printed, and the note says why

text        match {row}: an msh_book_text row key, applied by scripts/msh/npcs.py. 'read' is a fragment of a few words as the OCR gives it after folding to ASCII, 'printed' the same fragment as the page prints it. It must occur once in the row, or npcs.py stops. Applied in this file's order, each to the row as the one before left it.
also      further values of the same block, each {verdict, field, printed, and corrected for a misprint}: one override matches one block, and a block can print more than one thing to explain
checked   the date the page image was read

Each corrected Health or Karma is the sum of the printed numbers, the numbers kept, as MX1, MX3 and MT3 corrected theirs (survey decision 4). The five numbers inside their rank's range and not its standard (Magma's F, Marco Pene's F, E and I, Sunspot's R) are passed by the registry's rank_ranges, not here (decision 6).

overrides.note: A robot: printed Karma = 0, Resources = 0 and Popularity = 0, with R, I and P printed (6 Ty each), so Karma = R+I+P cannot hold. MX1, MX2 and MX3 print the same for their sentinels.
A robot, as the Mark IV: printed Karma = 0 with R 10 Gd, I 6 Ty and P 6 Ty.
A robot, as the Mark IV: printed Karma = 0 with R 10 Gd, I 10 Gd and P 6 Ty.

Printed Health = 250 (printed 25): F+A+S+E = 50+40+50+150 = 290, and MX1, MX2 and MX3 print the same seven numbers and Health 290. Its Karma = 0 is a robot's, as the Mark IV's, with R 20 Ex, I 10 Gd and P 10 Gd. Survey decision 4.
A robot, as the Mark IV: printed Karma = 0 with R 30 Rm, I 20 Ex and P 10 Gd.

Printed R 30 Ex, I 30 Gd and P 10 Ty (printed 26): Karma 70 = 30+30+10 holds on the numbers, so the codes are the misprints; 30 is Remarkable and 10 Good, as MA1 prints his R 30 Rm, I 30 Rm and P 10 Gd, and MX1's override corrects the same rows. Survey decision 4.
Printed Karma = 10 (printed 27): R+I+P = 10+10+20 = 40. His Health 90 holds on the S before the bracket (10, alternate 30 Rm). Survey decision 4.
Printed Health = 100 and Karma = 60 (printed 28): F+A+S+E = 16+20+10+40 = 86 and R+I+P = 30+20+20 = 70. No one mistyped row makes both hold. Survey decision 4.
Printed Health = 80 and Karma = 20 (printed 28): F+A+S+E = 30+20+10+30 = 90 and R+I+P = 10+20+40 = 70. No one mistyped row makes both hold. Survey decision 4.

Printed Karma = 150 with an asterisk (printed 29), keyed to a footnote under her grid: the figure is set by her standing as Raven Darkholme, not by her R, I and P (30+20+40 = 90). Kept as printed, as MT3's Kang's Varies. Survey decision 4.
Printed Health = 35 and Karma = 60 (printed 30): F+A+S+E = 16+20+10+15 = 61 and R+I+P = 10+16+20 = 46. MX3 prints the same seven numbers and its override corrects him to 61 and 46. Survey decision 4.
Printed Karma = 30 (printed 30): R+I+P = 16+10+20 = 46. His Health 76 holds on the S before the bracket (6, alternate 40 In). Survey decision 4.

Printed 28, Mirage's first power: the page breaks vision-enhancing after its hyphen at the end of a line (vision- / enhancing), and the reader joined it with the hyphen lost. A real compound: the line's books print the same shape mid-line (mind-enhancing in MHSP1, ability-enhancing in MHSP2, computer-enhanced in MA1 and MA4), so it keeps its hyphen (read on a 300 dpi crop of PDF 29; marvel-11 leftovers row 11b, under row 10's ruling, Nate 2026-11-03).

Printed 30, Marco Pene's background: the page breaks SWAT:AM after its A at the end of a line (SWA- / T:AM), a break inside the name that the reader kept as a hyphen and a space. The name is printed whole mid-line on PDF 9, 14 and 20 of this book and on MX2's card, so it is closed up whole (read on a 300 dpi crop of PDF 31; marvel-11 leftovers row 11b, under row 10's ruling, Nate 2026-11-03).
